title: ubuntu-cpc: use systemd-repart to build disk image
commit_message: ubuntu-cpc: use systemd-repart to build disk image
diff:
diff --git a/debian/control b/debian/control
index a823432..e1e5835 100644
--- a/debian/control
+++ b/debian/control
@@ -48,6 +48,7 @@ Depends: ${misc:Depends},
          xorriso [!i386],
          xz-utils,
          zerofree,
+         systemd-repart,
          zstd
 Breaks: ubuntu-defaults-builder (<< 0.32)
 Description: construction script for the livecd rootfs
diff --git a/live-build/functions b/live-build/functions
index 84ad5f4..5b04e26 100644
--- a/live-build/functions
+++ b/live-build/functions
@@ -96,6 +96,7 @@ mount_image() {
         exit 1
     fi
 
+    udevadm wait "$loop_device"
     # Find the rootfs location
     if [ "${rootpart}" -ge 0 ]; then
         echo "Using specified root partition '${rootpart}' to locate rootfs." >&2
@@ -268,10 +269,9 @@ get_device_partition_by_type_uuid() {
     local type_uuid="$1"
     local block_device="$2"
 
-    udevadm lock --device="${block_device}" \
-        lsblk -o PATH,PARTTYPE -nr "${block_device}" | \
-            awk -v type_uuid="${type_uuid}" \
-                '$2 == type_uuid { print $1; exit 0 }'
+    lsblk -o PATH,PARTTYPE -nr "${block_device}" | \
+        awk -v type_uuid="${type_uuid}" \
+            '$2 == type_uuid { print $1; exit 0 }'
 }
 
 get_esp_device_path() {
@@ -331,7 +331,7 @@ get_root_partition_device_path() {
     fi
 
     # Fallback to partition 1 for rootfs
-    echo "Failed to find root partition with GPT type UUID on ${block_device}" >&2
+    echo "Found to find root partition with GPT type UUID on ${block_device}" >&2
     echo "Falling back to partition 1 for rootfs" >&2
     echo "${block_device}p1"
 }
diff --git a/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/base/disk-image-uefi.binary b/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/base/disk-image-uefi.binary
index 5637bca..1069ebf 100755
--- a/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/base/disk-image-uefi.binary
+++ b/live-build/ubuntu-cpc/hooks.d/base/disk-image-uefi.binary
@@ -32,47 +32,26 @@ esac
 . config/functions
 
 create_partitions() {
-    disk_image="$1"
-    sgdisk "${disk_image}" --zap-all
-    case $ARCH in
-        arm64|armhf)
-            sgdisk "${disk_image}" \
-                   --new=15:0:204800 \
-                   --typecode=15:ef00 \
-                   --new=13::1G \
-                   --typecode=13:ea00 \
-                   --new=1: \
-                   --change-name=1:"$FS_LABEL" \
-                   --typecode=1:"$(gpt_root_partition_uuid $ARCH)"
-            ;;
-        riscv64)
-            sgdisk "${disk_image}" \
-                   --set-alignment=2 \
-                   --new=13::1G \
-                   --typecode=13:ea00 \
-                   --new=15::+106M \
-                   --typecode=15:ef00 \
-                   --new=1:: \
-                   --change-name=1:"$FS_LABEL" \
-                   --typecode=1:"$(gpt_root_partition_uuid $ARCH)" \
-                   --attributes=1:set:2
-            ;;
-        amd64)
-            sgdisk "${disk_image}" \
-                   --new=13::1G \
-                   --typecode=13:ea00 \
-                   --new=14::+4M \
-                   --new=15::+106M \
-                   --new=1::
-            sgdisk "${disk_image}" \
-                   --change-name=1:"$FS_LABEL" \
-                   -t 14:ef02 \
-                   -t 15:ef00 \
-                   -t 1:"$(gpt_root_partition_uuid $ARCH)"
-            ;;
-    esac
-    sgdisk "${disk_image}" \
-        --print
+    local disk_image="$1"
+    local bios_partition_type="21686148-6449-6e6f-744e-656564454649"
+    local repart_d=$(dirname $(readlink -f ${0}))/repart.d
+
+    if [ "$ARCH" = "amd64" ]; then
+        systemd-repart \
+          --dry-run=no \
+          --empty=allow \
+          --size=auto \
+          --definitions="$repart_d" \
+          "${disk_image}"
+    else
+        systemd-repart \
+          --dry-run=no \
+          --empty=allow \
+          --size=auto \
+          --exclude-partitions="$bios_partition_type" \
+          --definitions="$repart_d" \
+          "${disk_image}"
+    fi
 }
 
 create_and_mount_boot_partitions() {
@@ -80,9 +59,6 @@ create_and_mount_boot_partitions() {
     boot_dev="$(get_boot_partition_device_path ${loop_device})"
     mountpoint="$1"
 
-    mkfs.vfat -F 32 -n UEFI "${uefi_dev}"
-    mkfs.ext4 -L BOOT "${boot_dev}"
-
     # copying what was on the rootfs to the new boot partition
     mount "${boot_dev}" "${mountpoint}"/mnt
     mv "${mountpoint}"/boot/* "${mountpoint}"/mnt
@@ -204,7 +180,6 @@ create_partitions "${disk_image}"
 mount_image "${disk_image}" -1
 
 # Copy the chroot in to the disk
-make_ext4_partition "${rootfs_dev_mapper}"
 mkdir mountpoint
 mount "${rootfs_dev_mapper}" mountpoint
 cp -a chroot/* mountpoint/
